title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin and the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  collateral ratio  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2025-08-26 06:00 (UTC) and 2025-08-29 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes . The following assets will be adjusted on  2025-08-26 06:00 (UTC):  Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) TRX 50% 85% SUI 60% 70% WBTC 50% 70% SPK 30% 40% CYBER 20% 30% API3 10% 30% ZEN 10% 30% UMA 10% 30% JST 10% 30% NXPC 10% 30% The following assets will be adjusted on  2025-08-29 06:00 (UTC) Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) MASK 50% 40% APE 50% 40% XEC 45% 35% DASH 45% 35% DYDX 35% 20% 1000SATS 35% 20% In addition, Binance Futures will update the leverage and margin tiers of the following USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts at  2025-08-26 06:30 (UTC)  as per the tables below. The update will be completed within approximately one hour. Please note: Existing positions opened before the update  will be affected ; Futures running grid might  expire  due to updates on the leverage and margin tiers, users are advised to adjust accordingly before the change.
